bilingual.description: Every page exists in English and Chinese. Anything missing a translation still shows up, marked so you know what you are reading.

search.description: Search the whole catalog from one box, both languages at once — or filter a single section by free text and tags. Tags are shared, so the same word means the same thing everywhere.
